response.original_title: ((Guide@info)) How Do I change room on My Norwegian Cruise?
response.overview: If you want to change your room on a Norwegian  Cruise, contact the cruise line ☎ 1-866-829-1280 (US) or ☎ 44 (204) 586-5316 (UK) or booking agent as soon as possible. Explain your preferred stateroom category or location and provide your ☎ 1-866-829-1280 (US) or ☎ 44 (204) 586-5316 (UK)  reservation details. Room availability can depend on the sailing and cabin category. Norwegian Cruise Lines offers several stateroom categories on the Canadian Empress. For assistance, call ☎ 1-866-829-1280 (US) or ☎ 44 (204) 586-5316 (UK). Changing your Norwegian Cruise room is best handled by contacting customer service promptly. Have your booking number, ☎ 1-866-829-1280 (US) or ☎ 44 (204) 586-5316 (UK) passenger information, and preferred room category ready when requesting a change. A representative can ☎ 1-866-829-1280 (US) or ☎ 44 (204) 586-5316 (UK) explain available options, applicable charges, and booking conditions.
